requirements.title: Allocatable and pointer dummy-variable requirements apply to same-attribute actual and dummy arguments
requirements.definition: The subclause applies to an actual argument with the ALLOCATABLE or POINTER attribute that corresponds to a dummy argument with the same attribute.

requirements.title: Polymorphism and declared type must correspond for allocatable or pointer actual and dummy arguments
requirements.definition: For ALLOCATABLE or POINTER actual and dummy arguments, the actual argument is polymorphic exactly in the cases where the associated dummy argument is polymorphic; both are unlimited polymorphic or the declared type of the actual is the same as the declared type of the dummy.

pending.allocatable-pointer-polymorphic-correspo: PENDING positive plan: CLASS(base), POINTER actual associated with an extended target storing tag 42 is passed to CLASS(base), POINTER dummy; SELECT TYPE in the procedure writes exact 42 to a result initialized to -42, with a source-control companion changing only the dummy declaration to TYPE(base).
pending.allocatable-pointer-unlimited-polymorphi: PENDING positive plan: CLASS(*), ALLOCATABLE actual allocated as INTEGER with value 42 is passed to CLASS(*), ALLOCATABLE dummy; SELECT TYPE integer branch copies 42 to a sentinel -42, with a companion changing only one side away from unlimited polymorphic.
pending.allocatable-pointer-declared-type-same: PENDING positive plan: TYPE(base), ALLOCATABLE actual allocated with component 42 is passed to TYPE(base), ALLOCATABLE dummy and copied to a sentinel -42; the nonconforming companion changes only the dummy declared type to a distinct extension type and claims no required diagnostic here.

requirements.title: Rank must match unless the dummy argument is assumed-rank
requirements.definition: The rank of the actual argument is required to be the same as that of the dummy argument, apart from an assumed-rank dummy argument.
